title: Entry-Timing Confirmation via Maximum Adverse Excursion: An Empirical Test on a Systematic Index Futures Strategy
summary: Author claims Sharpe 1.38 to 3.33 for a proprietary Nifty MAE pullback overlay. Same-sample selection, unverifiable fills/paths and a false skipped-winner inference do not justify a fresh cross-book search.
about: Resting price-offset limits on a proprietary Nifty trend strategy, using original whole-trade MAE to infer eligibility and unchanged original exits.
findings: Authors report 12.3% to 31.9% CAGR, 1.38 to 3.33 Sharpe, 2.59 to 10.11 Sortino at 0.25%, retaining 2448/3908 trades, 2010-04-13 through 2026-01-30, with 6.02 bp modeled round-trip cost. Not independently replicated.
mechanism: Mechanical price improvement on retained fixed-exit trades; conviction/adverse-selection filtering is proposed but not isolated. Missed profitable exposure and deterioration can outweigh savings.
build_on: Retain execution diagnostic. Aggregate MAE is not automatically look-ahead for a causal resting order but cannot identify executable fill/path risk. No distinct qualified new strategy or current-book gain established; preserve prior timing search history.
code_feasibility: A causally specified fixed-parent offset-limit wrapper is codeable with known signals, native tick/fees, exact expiry and complete paths. Proprietary Nifty signal/returns cannot be reproduced. Only source/mechanical audit code built.
source_revision: Purvang Gandhi, MTS Institute, July 2026; 12-page user upload
